treks.additionalInfo: The Langtang Valley is the third most popular trekking location in Nepal, offering a classic Himalayan adventure that combines profound natural beauty with culturally enriching experiences.

faqs.question: Where is the Langtang Valley Trek located?
faqs.answer: The Langtang Valley Trek is located north of Kathmandu in the Rasuwa district of the Bagmati Province in Nepal. The trek is in the Langtang National Park.

faqs.question: How Difficult is Langtang Valley Trek?
faqs.answer: The Langtang Valley Trek is graded as moderate. While it does not require technical climbing skills, it involves walking for several hours each day and ascending to high altitudes.

faqs.question: What permits are required for the Langtang Valley trek?
faqs.answer: You will need to obtain a Langtang National Park entry permit and a TIMS (Trekkers' Information Management System) card.

treks.title: Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve Tour 13 Days
treks.description: Are you crazy about wildlife, and the thought of hunting crazy animals in the wild excites you? If it does excite you, then a hunting tour to Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve, the only legal hunting ground in Nepal, can be a thrilling experience for you. Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve is one of Nepal’s historically most significant conservation areas. It was established in 1983, was finally gazetted in 1987 to protect from illegal poaching activities and is spread over districts Rukum, Myagdi and Baglung in the western part of Nepal. The Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve area is about 1,325 square kilometres, and it is the sole hunting reserve in Nepal and a special place for hunters and nature lovers. The reserve has a diverse landscape that includes alpine meadows, dense forests, and marshlands known as “ḍhor,” which provide habitats for various wildlife. This area contains 36 endemic plant species, 18 mammal species, and 137 bird species, and thus is a valuable biodiversity hotspot. The trip usually starts in Kathmandu, and then a beautiful drive to Beni and then to Darbang starts the trek. Not only is Dhorpatan a hunters’ paradise, but it is a natural attraction where environmentally conscious tourists can enjoy the virgin setting, walking and looking for wildlife.

quickFacts.bestSeason: Autumn (Sept to Nov) and Spring (March to May)

highlights: Explore and hunt in Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve, the only legal hunting ground in Nepal.
Controlled Hunting activities primarily targeting blue sheep and Himalayan tahr.
Witness over 80,000 animals living within the grazing land of Dhorpatan.
Explore a biodiversity hotspot home to snow leopards, musk deer, blue sheep, and 137 bird species.
Explore three distinct forest types: alpine, sub-alpine, and high-temperate vegetation.
A naturalist guide to help recognize the wildlife and navigate the hunting blocks.
Visit the Hindu temple Dhorbaraha on the banks of the Uttarganga River.
Experience rich cultural immersion in villages inhabited by Magar, Thakali, and Gurung communities.

itinerary.details: Take an exciting 3-hour off-road private jeep ride to Darbang. Have lunch, then begin a 2-hour relaxing trek to Dharapani for the night.

itinerary.details: Trek 6 hours passing through Sibang and Mattim. Enjoy the steady climbs, flat stretches, and glimpses of rural life before reaching Lamsung.

itinerary.details: Trek 7 hours on a difficult day of walking. Ascend through tropical forests, gaining a lot of altitude, but enjoy incredible views of Dhaulagiri and Chure.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tallo Jaljale to Dhorpatan (2860m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5 hours descending gradually through beautiful open meadows and dense pine forests, arriving at Dhorpatan, the heart of the hunting reserve.

itinerary.title: Hunt in Dhorpatan and Explore Phagune Phedi (Days 6-9)
itinerary.details: Spend these 4 days hunting! Set up camp, practice hunting skills, and explore the designated blocks (limit one animal per permit). Non-hunters can trek to Phagune Phedi.

itinerary.title: Hunting and Exploration Day
itinerary.details: Continued hunting and exploration in the Dhorpatan Reserve.

itinerary.title: Hunting and Exploration Day
itinerary.details: Continued hunting and exploration in the Dhorpatan Reserve.

itinerary.title: Hunting and Exploration Day
itinerary.details: Continued hunting and exploration in the Dhorpatan Reserve. Move to Jungle Camp in the evening.

itinerary.title: Trek from Jungle Camp to Gurjaghat (3019m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5 hours with slight ascents and descents through panoramic forest and mountain views to the peaceful settlement of Gurjaghat.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gurjaghat to Patichaur (1800m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5 hours descending steeply through forested ridges, traditional villages, and farming areas into the warmer climate of Patichaur.

itinerary.title: Trek to Darbang and Drive to Beni (899m)
itinerary.details: Trek 2 hours in the morning to Darbang, then take a 3-hour drive back to Beni where you can enjoy a hot shower.

itinerary.title: Drive from Beni to Kathmandu (1400m)
itinerary.details: Take an 8-hour drive retracing the route back to Kathmandu, enjoying the final views of the rivers and hills.

faqs.question: What is the cost for hunting in Dhorpatan for a Nepalese?
faqs.answer: The cost for hunting in Dhorpatan ranges from NPR 3,30,000 for Himalayan Tahr to NPR 9,26,000 for Blue Sheep.

faqs.question: Are there hunting seasons in the Dhorpatan Reserve?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are two major Dhorpatan hunting seasons: the first one up to December and the second one from mid-February to mid-April.

faqs.question: What happens in case of an emergency?
faqs.answer: In case of emergencies, one should immediately contact local authorities or one’s trekking guide. It is also wise to bring a first-aid kit and to study information about the nearest medical facilities before heading into some remote areas.

treks.title: Jomsom Muktinath Tour 9 Days
treks.description: The Jomsom-Muktinath trail is one of the most popular trekking routes attracting about 75% tourists every year. Majority of these tourists are people who are looking to visit the holy temple of Muktinath, which sits at an altitude of 3800m. The Jomsom Muktinath Tour is an excellent alternative for people looking to visit the sacred shrine of Muktinath without undertaking the long and exhausting trekking route. Surrounded by desolate mountains and glistening mountains, Jomsom is undoubtedly a treat to any traveler’s eye! It is also a central hub of Mustang which opens the gateway to other fantastic trekking routes such as Upper Mustang or Manang. A few kilometers ahead from Jomsom lies the Muktinath temple. Muktinath temple is a sacred shrine for Buddhists and Hindus. Thousands of devotees flock every year offering their prayers to the holy deity. It is also believed that bathing yourself in the well-famed 108 showers of Muktinath purifies your soul. So, sign up for this Jomsom Muktinath Road Adventure and experience the thrilling adventure as you pass through the lush high-altitude forests, alluring alpine meadows and the majestic mountain views along the rugged off-road tracks.
highlights: Thrilling jeep tour through the rugged off-road tracks.
Witnessing the stunning Kali Gandaki Valley and Kagbeni.
Enjoy the sights of Annapurna mountain range and Mt. Dhaulagiri.
Explore the World's deepest gorge of Kali Gandaki.
Visit a Tibetan-influenced village filled with prayer wheels, chortens & a Buddhist monastery.
The highest point is Muktinath (3800 m), a holy site sacred to both Buddhists and Hindus.
In Jomsom and Marpha, enjoy the famed local apples, apple pie, and apple wine/brandy.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Our representatives will meet you at the airport and escort you to the hotel. Spend the rest of the day exploring the city or relaxing.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Pokhara (822m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic 6-7 hour drive along the Trishuli River to the beautiful lakeside city of Pokhara. Transfer to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Drive to Tatopani (1190m) from Pokhara
itinerary.details: Drive 5 hours through Beni and Kusma on a twisting gravel road to Tatopani. Relax in the natural hot spring pool on the banks of the Kali Gandaki River.

itinerary.title: Drive from Tatopani to Jomsom (2800m)
itinerary.details: Drive 5-6 hours following the Kali Gandaki River into the desolate, mountain landscapes of Jomsom. Explore the town in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Drive from Jomsom to Muktinath (3800m)
itinerary.details: Drive 2 hours via the small settlement of Kagbeni. Reach Muktinath and explore the stupas, monasteries, and the Jwala Mai Fire temple.

itinerary.title: Drive from Muktinath to Marpha (2650m)
itinerary.details: Drive 5-6 hours descending back past Jomsom to the picturesque village of Marpha. Famous for its white-washed houses, stone-paved streets, and apple orchards.

itinerary.title: Drive from Marpha to Pokhara (822m)
itinerary.details: Drive 6 hours back along the Kali Gandaki River, passing through Larjung and Ghasa, finally arriving in Pokhara for the night.

itinerary.title: Flight from Pokhara to Kathmandu (1400m)
itinerary.details: Take a quick, scenic 30-minute flight from Pokhara back to Kathmandu. Transfer to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.details: Our representatives will drop you off at the Tribhuvan International Airport for your onward journey.

faqs.question: Which is the best season for Jomsom Muktinath tour?
faqs.answer: Autumn (Mid-September to Mid-December) is the best tour season. Spring (February to mid-June) is the second busiest season, offering excellent views.

faqs.question: What food do we get in mountain?
faqs.answer: The teahouses provide a variety of meals, from traditional Nepali Dal Bhat to noodles, soups, and seasonal vegetables, along with famous local apples in Marpha.

treks.title: Annapurna North Base Camp Trek 12 Days
treks.description: In 1950, a French expedition team under the leadership of Maurice Herzog was the first climber in history to reach the top of Annapurna I. They headed to the North Face of Annapurna after concluding that Dhaulagiri was too challenging. The Annapurna North Base Camp Trek, also known as the French North Face Route, has gained popularity recently for adventurers wanting to retrace Maurice Herzog's historic trail. We provide this unique trekking itinerary for those individuals interested in the wilderness and less explored areas in the famous Annapurna region. Although the trail can be challenging with its rugged wilderness and tented camps, you can undoubtedly experience the Himalayas’ splendor from a variety of sweeping perspectives. Natural hot springs, Gurung culture, Hiunchuli, Machhapuchhre, Dhaulagiri, Annapurna I, Nilgiri, and Annapurna South are the trek’s primary highlights. Currently, there are no teahouses on the main segment, making this a true wilderness adventure with tented camping under the stars.
highlights: North ABC Trek is a moderately challenging trek with the amazing natural beauty of the Himalayas including flora and fauna.
A combination of both tea house and camping, offering mesmerizing views of Annapurna I, Machhapuchhre, Himchuli, Nilgiri, and Dhaulagiri.
Experience the dense lush jungle, waterfalls, hot springs, caves, and glaciers.
Explore Narchyang Lake which remains frozen during the winter season.
Chance to encounter musk deer, snow leopards, bears, wild dogs, and blue sheep.
Experience the culture, tradition, and hospitality of the Magar and Thakali communities.
Rejuvenate in the natural hot springs at Tatopani.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Welcome to Nepal! Our representative will meet you at the airport and transfer you to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu (1300m) to Pokhara (822m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic 7-hour tourist bus ride (or an optional 25-minute flight) to the beautiful lakeside city of Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Drive to Tatopani (1243m) & Trek to Upper Narchyang (2140m)
itinerary.details: Drive early from Pokhara to Tatopani. Relax in the hot springs if you wish, then begin a 2-hour trek to Upper Narchyang, the last village with teahouses.

itinerary.title: Trek from Upper Narchyang (2140m) to Chhotepa (2369m)
itinerary.details: Trek 7 hours on a difficult, slick, and rocky trail. Cross the Mristi Khola and set up your first wilderness tented camp at Chhotepa.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chhotepa (2369m) to Sandhi Kharka (3165m)
itinerary.details: Trek 7 hours (9km) passing stunning waterfalls, streams, and the charming area of Humkhola before reaching your camp at Sandhi Kharka.

itinerary.title: Trek from Sandhi Kharka (3165m) to Annapurna North Base Camp (4190m)
itinerary.details: Trek 7-8 hours (10km) uphill into the foothills of the North Face. Reach the Maurice Herzog base camp and soak in the breathtaking mountain scenery.

itinerary.title: Trek from Annapurna North Base Camp (4190m) to Sandhi Kharka (3165m)
itinerary.details: Spend the morning exploring the base camp and glaciers beneath Annapurna I and Mt. Fish Tail. Then, trek 8 hours back down to Sandhi Kharka.

itinerary.title: Trek from Sandhi Kharka (3165m) to Thulo Bugin (3500m)
itinerary.details: Trek 7 hours passing through lush rhododendron forests and small streams. Spend the night at the Thulo Bugin tented camp.

itinerary.title: Trek from Thulo Bugin (3500m) to Lete (2010m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5 hours traversing the high Thulo Bugin Pass, dropping back down into civilization at Lete in the Mustang district. Stay in a teahouse.

itinerary.title: Drive from Lete (2010m) to Pokhara (822m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic 5-hour jeep drive back to Pokhara, enjoying the views of the Annapurna range. Relax at Phewa Lake in the evening.

itinerary.title: Drive from Pokhara (822m) to Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Take a 7-hour tourist bus drive back to Kathmandu. Enjoy your final evening shopping or exploring Thamel.

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.details: Our airport shuttle service will transfer you to the airport 3 hours before your flight. Have a safe journey!

faqs.question: What Can I Expect from the Annapurna North Base Camp Trek?
faqs.answer: You will enjoy breathtaking vistas of Annapurna, Nilgiri, and Dhaulagiri from the less explored northern face. The trek offers a mix of teahouse and wilderness camping, chances to encounter rare wildlife like snow panthers and blue sheep, rich cultural interactions with Magar and Thakali communities, and a soak in natural hot springs.

faqs.question: Is this a teahouse trek?
faqs.answer: No, this is a hybrid trek. You will spend 2 nights in teahouses at the start and end of the trek, but the 5 nights in the wilderness will be in fully-supported tented camps, as there is no infrastructure on the trail to North Base Camp.

treks.title: Khopra Danda Trek 6 Days
treks.description: This trek takes you through lesser-known paths to Khopra Danda while letting you experience traditional villages, terraced farms, and amazing mountain peaks (including Mt Dhaulagiri, Annapurna, Nilgiri, Tukuche Peak), and Poon Hill in the Annapurna region. Your journey begins with a scenic ride from Kathmandu through Pokhara, Nayapul, and Syauli Bazaar to Kimche, and finally to the Gurung village of Ghandruk. From Ghandruk, you will trek to Tadapani and Bayli Kharka, enjoying the Homely feel of community lodges. On the third day, you will reach Khopra Danda, passing through Chistibang pastures and timberline forests. The views from the ridge are simply awe-inspiring. You also have the option to hike to the sacred Khayar Lake at 4500m. The trek continues through Swanta village, known for its community-run cheese factory, before joining the classic trails to Ghorepani. On the final morning, you will ascend Poon Hill for a world-renowned sunrise over the Himalayas.
highlights: One of the shorter, less popular, and moderate treks in the Annapurna region.
Enjoy the breathtaking dawn over Dhaulagiri and the Annapurna while staying at a teahouse during the Khopra ridge community trek.
Awe-inspiring views of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna South, and Nilgiri.
Optional hike to the holy lake of Khayar (4500m) at the base of Annapurna South.
Magnificent dawn and sunset views from Poon Hill and Khopra Ridge.
Exploring the traditional way of life in Ghandruk and Swanta, including a local cheese factory.
Trek on off-the-beaten-track trails away from the main crowds.

itinerary.title: Drive from Pokhara to Kimche (1940m). Trek from Ghandruk to Tadapani (2700m)
itinerary.details: Drive by Jeep to Nayapul and off-road to Kimche/Ghandruk. Hike 4 hours through rhododendron woods to Tadapani.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tadapani (2700m) to Bayeli Kharka (3450m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5 hours through open countryside and local water buffalo pastures, gradually ascending to Bayeli Kharka with superb views of Mt. Dhaulagiri.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bayli Kharka (3450m) to Khopra Danda (3660m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5 hours descending through forests to Chistibang pastures and ascending above timberlines to Khopra Danda. Enjoy views of the Kaligandaki Gorge and surrounding peaks.

itinerary.title: Trek from Khopra Danda (3660m) to Swanta (2214m)
itinerary.details: Optional morning hike to the sacred Khayar Lake (4665m) taking 5 hours. Then trek down to Swanta village, known for its community cheese factory.

itinerary.title: Trek from Swanta (2214m) to Ghorepani (2880m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5 hours descending through village fields, crossing a suspension bridge, and ascending to Chittre to join the classic trail up to Ghorepani.

itinerary.title: Hike to Poon Hill (3210m), trek to Birethanti, Drive to Pokhara
itinerary.details: Early morning hike to Poon Hill for sunrise. Trek down to Birethanti and catch a Jeep back to Pokhara, ending your trek.

faqs.question: How long do we have to walk every day?
faqs.answer: Normally as per our itinerary, we walk about 5-6 hours a day. But it all depends on your fitness level. Above 4000m (if you go to Khayar Lake), your pace will be slower.

faqs.question: Do we get hot shower in Mountain?
faqs.answer: Hot showers are available but you have to pay for it. We suggest not to take a shower when you are above 4500m to avoid catching a cold.

faqs.question: What do we do if incase of altitude sickness?
faqs.answer: If you get altitude sickness symptoms, descend to lower elevation or use first aid. If the condition gets worse, you may be evacuated by helicopter to a nearby hospital.

treks.title: Everest View Trek Nepal 7 Days
treks.description: The Everest panorama view trek journey will begin with a scenic flight to Lukla Airport. After arriving in Lukla, you will start the trek on the Dudh Koshi River banks and enter the gateway of Everest - Namche Bazaar. You will acclimatize in this famous Sherpa town for a day, exploring the local yak farm, Edmund Hillary-funded school, and enjoying views from the Everest View Hotel. The Everest View Trek is a short alternative trek for those who want to avoid altitude sickness but still enjoy the views of Everest. Along with Mt. Everest, you will also see the world's other high peaks, such as Mt. Lhotse (8,516m) and Cho Oyu (8,201m), while trekking through the Sagarmatha National Park and visiting ancient monasteries like Tengboche.

quickFacts.bestSeason: March, April, May, September, October, November

highlights: Scenic flight to Lukla.
Stunning views of Mount Everest (8,848m) without extreme altitudes.
Relaxed and easy trek in the Everest region.
Trek through the Sagarmatha National Park (UNESCO World Heritage site).
Explore the famous Sherpa town - Namche Bazaar.
Spot highland wildlife like musk deer and Himalayan Monal.
Visit the ancient monastery in Tengboche.
Wide range of flora and fauna in high-altitude pine and rhododendron forests.

itinerary.title: Flight from Kathmandu/Manthali to Lukla (2850m). Trek to Phakding (2650m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic flight to Lukla. Begin your trek downhill to the Dudh Koshi River, cross a suspension bridge, and hike 3 hours to Phakding.

itinerary.title: Trek from Phakding (2650m) to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6 hours crossing the Hillary suspension bridge. Register at the Sagarmatha National Park check post and climb through dense forests into Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Rest day to acclimatize at Namche Bazaar
itinerary.details: Acclimatize by exploring the town's cafes and bakeries. Hike up to the Everest View Hotel and the Sherpa towns of Khunde and Khumjung for epic mountain views.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche (3440m) to Tengboche (3855m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours with spectacular views of Everest, Lhotse, and Ama Dablam. Descend to the river, then climb through pine forests to the famous Tengboche monastery.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tengboche (3855m) to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5 hours retracing your steps back to Namche Bazaar, passing through dense forests, prayer flags, and chortens, watching for wildlife.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche Bazaar (3440m) to Lukla (2850m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours descending the steep trail back to the Dudh Koshi valley. Arrive in Lukla to celebrate the conclusion of your trek.

itinerary.title: Fly back to Kathmandu/Manthali from Lukla (2850m)
itinerary.details: Take your morning flight back from Lukla. Depending on the season, you will fly directly to Kathmandu or to Manthali followed by a drive.

treks.title: Upper Mustang Jeep Tour 8 Days
treks.description: The Upper Mustang Jeep tour is a short yet exciting journey that allows you to explore the dramatic landscapes amidst the forbidden Kingdom, Lo Manthang, and the cultural significance of the Upper Mustang. This exhilarating ride is a perfect blend of convenience within a short period to immerse in the arid valleys surrounded by the Himalayas. Upper Mustang used to be a secluded area as foreigners weren’t allowed trekking. However, this beautiful place immediately became popular among tourists after opening it to foreigners in 1992. The 8-day overland drive begins with a scenic jeep drive from Kathmandu to Pokhara. Then, you will reach the capital city of Upper Mustang, Lo Manthang, crossing Tatopani, Ghilling, and other remote villages. You will have an entire day to explore the cultural and traditional significance of the region, including the ancient King's Palace and Chhoser Cave. The tour concludes by exploring the holy Muktinath temple and driving through the deepest Kali Gandaki Gorge.

quickFacts.bestSeason: All season (Best in Spring and Autumn)

highlights: Discover the history of the ancient Kingdom of Lo Manthang, the capital city of Upper Mustang.
Interact with the Bon and Lobha ethnic tribe people and experience their unique Himalayan lifestyle.
Visit the five-storied white-washed King’s Palace, the oldest structure in Lo Manthang.
Discover arid desert-like landscapes in the Kali Gandaki River Valley.
Magnificent Himalayan views, including Annapurna massifs, Dhaulagiri ranges, and Nilgiri.
Visit the holy Muktinath temple and beautiful apple orchards in Marpha.
Explore Champa Lhakang, Namgyal Gompa, and Tsechen Shedrubling Monastery School.
Explore the mysterious ancient Chhoser Cave (Jhong Cave).

itinerary.title: Kathmandu to Pokhara on Jeep (820m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic 7-8 hour drive along the Prithvi Highway, following the Trishuli River to the beautiful lakeside city of Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Drive From Pokhara To Tatopani (1190m)
itinerary.details: Drive 5 hours through Baglung and Beni. Off-roading starts after Beni, leading you to Tatopani where you can enjoy the natural hot springs.

itinerary.title: Drive to Ghilling (3570m)
itinerary.details: Drive 6 hours making your way through Kagbeni and Chhusang. Notice the landscape shift to a desert-like atmosphere as you reach Ghilling.

itinerary.title: Drive to Lo Manthang (3800m)
itinerary.details: Drive 3 hours passing through Ghami and crossing the Tsarang La pass. Visit Ghar Gompa before arriving in the walled capital city of Lo Manthang.

itinerary.title: Explore Lo Manthang
itinerary.details: Spend a full day exploring Lo Manthang on foot. Visit the King's Palace, Champa Lhakang, Namgyal Gompa, and the ancient Chhoser Cave.

itinerary.title: Drive to Marpha Exploring Muktinath (3800m), Kagbeni (2804m), and Jomsom (2650m)
itinerary.details: Drive 7.5 hours back down the valley. Visit the sacred Muktinath temple, pass through Kagbeni and Jomsom, and spend the night in the apple capital, Marpha.

itinerary.title: Drive from Marpha to Pokhara (822m)
itinerary.details: Take a 7-hour drive (161 km) back down the Kali Gandaki valley. Return to Pokhara to enjoy boating on Phewa Lake and the vibrant nightlife.

itinerary.title: Fly Back to Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Take a hassle-free, scenic 35-minute flight from Pokhara back to Kathmandu. Our representative will transfer you to your hotel.

faqs.question: Are there any other routes for the Upper Mustang Jeep Tour?
faqs.answer: Yes, depending on your preferences, you can take a flight from Pokhara to Jomsom and start the jeep tour via Chhusang directly to Lo Manthang.

faqs.question: Where is the Upper Mustang located?
faqs.answer: Upper Mustang, an arid river valley, is located north of the Annapurna Circuit, covering about two-thirds of the Mustang District in the Gandaki Province.

faqs.question: Do I need permits to explore the Upper Mustang area?
faqs.answer: Yes, you will need a special Restricted Area Permit for Upper Mustang as well as an Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP).

treks.title: Once upon a time in Kathmandu (Day Tour)
treks.description: A day trip to five of Kathmandu’s UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Because of their historical, religious, and cultural significance, the majority of the sightseeing tour’s stops are UNESCO World Heritage Sites. You will visit Patan Durbar Square, Swayambhunath ‘Monkey Sanctuary’, Pashupatinath, Boudhanath, and Kathmandu Durbar Square. Every one of them has its own engineering, strict and verifiable worth built in the past by Rulers. Explore sacred Buddhist stupas, holy Hindu sanctuaries, and marvel at the intricate Newari architecture of the ancient royal palaces.
highlights: A comprehensive day trip to five of Kathmandu’s UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
Visit Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple) and enjoy a panoramic view of Kathmandu valley.
Explore Boudhanath, one of the largest spherical stupas in Nepal.
Witness the holy Hindu rituals at the Pashupatinath Temple on the banks of Bagmati River.
Marvel at the Newari architecture in Patan Durbar Square.
Visit Kathmandu Durbar Square, home to the Living Goddess Kumari and ancient palaces.
Private transfer and English-speaking tour guide for a hassle-free experience.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu UNESCO World Heritage Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.details:
8:30 AM: Drive to Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple).
10:30 AM: Explore Boudhanath Stupa.
12:30 PM: Visit Pashupatinath Temple.
2:30 PM: Marvel at Patan Durbar Square.
4:30 PM: Visit Kathmandu Durbar Square (Basantapur).
6:00 PM: Return to Hotel.

costIncludes: A private car for the city tour.
A driver and all parking fees.
An English-speaking tour guide.
Bottle of mineral water.
Pick up from the hotel and drop off (City center only).
costExcludes: Entry fees for the temples, stupas, and monasteries.
All meals and snacks during the day.
Tips for the driver and guide.
treks.additionalInfo: The Kathmandu day tour usually starts early at 8:30 AM to beat the morning traffic. Dress modestly, especially when visiting Pashupatinath. You will need to take off your shoes when entering certain temple areas.

treks.title: Market to Mouth (Authentic Cooking Class)
treks.description: Immerse yourself in the flavors of Nepal with our Market to Mouth authentic cooking class. Hosted in a tranquil neighborhood near Swayambhunath, this hands-on experience begins with a guided tour of a vibrant local market. Learn about essential Nepali ingredients and the art of blending spices. Then, step into a clean, well-equipped kitchen to prepare iconic dishes like Momos, Dal Bhat, seasonal curries, and a Nepali-style dessert. Conclude the experience by savoring your culinary creations with new friends.

quickFacts.meals: Lunch or Dinner (The meal you prepare)

highlights: Market Tour: Guided exploration of a vibrant local market to learn about Nepali ingredients and spices.
The Art of Spices: Learn how to grind and blend traditional spice mixes used in classic dishes.
Hands-on Cooking: Prepare authentic Nepalese dishes like Dal-Bhat, Momos, and regional specialties.
Enjoy Your Creation: Savor the delicious meal you prepared in a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
Cultural Immersion: Try on local Nepalese dresses for fun photos.

itinerary.title: Market Tour and Cooking Class (10:00 AM - 3:00 PM)
itinerary.details:
10:00 AM: Pick up from your hotel.
10:30 AM: Guided local market excursion and welcome introduction at the cooking studio.
11:00 AM - 1:00 PM: Hands-on cooking workshop preparing Momos, Dal Bhat, and more.
1:00 PM - 2:00 PM: Savor your creations during lunch.
2:00 PM - 2:30 PM: Relaxation, socialize, and optionally wear local dresses for photos.
3:00 PM: Farewell and drop-off back at your hotel.

Instruction in a clean and well-equipped kitchen.
Cooking equipment and accessories.

English-speaking guide for the market tour.

treks.additionalInfo: The class is operated by locals near Swayambhunath. Please note that while the schedule mentions a hotel pick-up/drop-off, the official inclusions note that transportation to the class is excluded (please confirm transportation arrangements upon booking).

faqs.question: Can you accommodate dietary restrictions?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can accommodate your dietary restrictions with advanced notice. Please inform us about any allergies or preferences during the booking.

faqs.question: What is the schedule and availability?
faqs.answer: We offer flexible scheduling options to fit your travel itinerary.

treks.title: Everest Base Camp & Gokyo Lakes Trek 15 Days
treks.description: The 15-day Everest Base Camp Trek via the Gokyo Lakes trip takes adventurous trekkers to the fabulous Gokyo Valley, the source of grand Dudh Koshi River, the large Ngozumpa Glacier, the famous Cho La pass, and the celebrated viewpoints of Gokyo Ri and Kala Patthar. This along with Everest Base Camp, majestically soaring mountains, friendly Sherpas, colorful monasteries, prayer flags, Namche Bazaar, and Sagarmatha National Park makes for the trip of a lifetime. Gokyo, a hidden valley with gorgeous blue lakes in the lap of the Himalayas, has its own reputation among adventurous souls. You will enjoy 360-degree panoramic views of four 8000-meter peaks combining the best of the Everest Region.
highlights: Scenic 40-minute flights Kathmandu-Lukla-Kathmandu.
Explore Namche Bazaar - the Sherpa Capital.
Trek through Sagarmatha National Park (UNESCO World Heritage Site).
Discover the hidden Gokyo valley, Gokyo Lakes, and cross the Cho La Pass (5,420m).
Impressive view of Khumbu Ice Fall.
Prayer wheels, colorful flags, Mani stones, high suspension bridges.
Reach the iconic Everest Base Camp (5,364m).
Stunning views of peaks over 8000m including Mt. Everest (8,848m) from Kala Patthar (5,555m).

itinerary.title: Flight to Lukla. Trek to Phakding (2650m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic flight to Lukla (direct from Kathmandu or via Manthali). Begin your trek with a 3-hour hike downhill to Phakding.

itinerary.title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6 hours crossing the Hillary suspension bridge. Register at the Sagarmatha National Park check post and climb through dense forests into Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Rest day and acclimatization at Namche Bazaar
itinerary.details: Acclimatize by hiking to the Everest View Hotel, Khunde, or Khumjung. Visit the Sagarmatha National Park Visitor Center.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche to Dole (4200m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5 hours branching off the classic EBC trail towards the Gokyo Valley. Pass Mong La and descend through pine forests before arriving in Dole.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dole to Machhermo (4470m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6 hours climbing a scenic ridge above Dole, passing summer settlements, and arriving at Machhermo, known for the 1974 Yeti sighting.

itinerary.title: Trek from Machhermo to Gokyo (4790m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4 hours alongside the Ngozumpa Glacier. Marvel at the shimmering turquoise waters of the first, second, and third Gokyo Lakes.

itinerary.title: Rest day at Gokyo. Hike Gokyo Ri (5400m)
itinerary.details: Hike 2 hours up Gokyo Ri for unparalleled 360-degree panoramic views of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu. Explore the Gokyo valley.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gokyo to Thangnak (4700m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5 hours navigating across the rocky, undulating Ngozumpa Glacier to reach Thangnak at the base of Cho La Pass.

itinerary.title: Trek from Thangnak to Dzongla (4855m) via Cho La Pass (5420m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours starting early. Ascend the steep, icy Cho La Pass for magnificent views before a slippery descent into Dzongla.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dzongla to Lobuche (4910m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4 hours following the moraine and rejoining the classic EBC trail. Pass memorials of fallen climbers before arriving at Lobuche.

itinerary.title: Trek Lobuche to Everest Base Camp (5364m), back to Gorak Shep (5185m)
itinerary.details: Trek 7 hours to Gorak Shep, drop your bags, and make the final push to Everest Base Camp. Celebrate your achievement and return to Gorak Shep for the night.

itinerary.title: Hike Kala Patthar (5555m). Trek to Pheriche (4250m)
itinerary.details: Hike 2 hours early morning up Kala Patthar for sunrise over Everest. Descend to Gorak Shep, then trek 5 hours down the valley to Pheriche.

itinerary.title: Trek from Pheriche to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours descending rapidly back into the tree line, passing Tengboche monastery, and returning to the lively Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche Bazaar to Lukla (2850m)
itinerary.details: Trek 7 hours retracing your steps across the suspension bridges of the Dudh Koshi to Lukla. Enjoy a farewell celebration with your guides.

itinerary.title: Fly back to Kathmandu/Manthali from Lukla
itinerary.details: Take a morning flight back from Lukla to conclude your epic Himalayan adventure.

treks.additionalInfo: During peak seasons (Mar-May, Sep-Nov), Lukla flights are typically routed via Manthali Airport, requiring a 5-hour midnight drive from Kathmandu. Direct helicopter upgrades are available for approx. $550 USD.

treks.title: Annapurna Circuit Trek 12 Days
treks.description: The 12-day Annapurna Circuit Trek is one of the most famous treks in Nepal, located within the Annapurna Conservation Area Project (ACAP). The trek ascends from 800m through lush rice paddy fields and subtropical forests up to the dramatic 5,416m Thorong La Pass, surrounded by glacial zones. The trek offers unparalleled panoramic views of the Himalayas, including Mt. Dhaulagiri (8,167m), Mt. Annapurna I (8,091m), Mt. Manaslu (8,163m), and many other towering peaks. Highlights include bathing in the natural hot springs in Chame, exploring the Tibetan-style Buddhist village of Manang, and visiting the sacred Muktinath Temple with its 108 stone faucets. The journey ends with a scenic flight from Jomsom to Pokhara, followed by a drive back to Kathmandu.

quickFacts.bestSeason: All season (Best in Spring and Autumn)

highlights: Climb to the elevation of 5,416 meters at the challenging Thorong La Pass.
Trek through diverse climatic zones, from subtropical forests to high alpine glacial zones.
Discover the Nepalese mountain culture as you pass through small Tibetan-style villages.
Visit the 108 stone faucets at the sacred Muktinath Temple, revered by Hindus and Buddhists.
Explore the largest Monastery of Manang in Braga.
Take a scenic flight from Jomsom to Pokhara with breathtaking views of the Annapurna Range.
Stunning views of Mt. Annapurna, Thorung Peak, Nilgiri, Chulu, Tukuche Peak, Dhaulagiri, and Lamjung Himal.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Our representative will receive you at the airport and transfer you to your hotel. Rest, explore Kathmandu, and attend a trek briefing in the evening.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Dharapani (1860m)
itinerary.details: Take an 8-hour private Jeep drive early morning, following the Marsayangdi River. Pass through Ngadi, Bahundanda, and Tal before registering at Dharapani.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dharapani to Chame (2610m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6 hours into alpine territory. Walk through pine forests, apple orchards, and the villages of Timang and Koto before reaching Chame, the Manang district headquarters.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chame to Upper Pisang (3300m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6 hours through a stunning rocky valley and pine forests. Cross suspension bridges and pass Dhikur Pokhari to arrive at Upper Pisang, offering views of Pisang Peak and Annapurna II.

itinerary.title: Trek from Upper Pisang to Manang (3540m)
itinerary.details: Trek 7 hours via the higher route (Ghyaru and Ngawal) for magnificent views of the Annapurna range. Visit the Braga Monastery before arriving in the bustling Manang bazaar.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization at Manang (3540m)
itinerary.details: Rest day. Take a short acclimatization hike to Gangapurna Lake or a longer side trip to Ice Lake for stunning landscapes and better adaptation to the altitude.

itinerary.title: Trek from Manang to Ledar (4200m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4 hours ascending out of the Marshyangdi Valley. Pass through Yak Kharka meadows, where yaks and blue sheep graze, before reaching the small hamlet of Ledar.

itinerary.title: Trek from Ledar to Thorung Phedi (4525m) or High Camp (4925m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4-5 hours up into the rocky, deserted high-altitude terrain. Depending on weather and stamina, stay at Thorung Phedi or push on to High Camp to make tomorrow easier.

itinerary.title: Trek to Muktinath (3760m) via Thorung La Pass (5416m). Drive to Jomsom (2720m)
itinerary.details: Start early to conquer the steep 5,416m Thorung La Pass. Descend to the sacred Muktinath Temple for lunch, then take a scenic drive down the windy Kali Gandaki valley to Jomsom.

itinerary.title: Take Flight from Jomsom to Pokhara (822m)
itinerary.details: Take an early morning 30-minute flight from Jomsom to Pokhara. Spend the rest of the day relaxing, boating on Phewa Lake, or exploring the city's sights.

itinerary.title: Drive from Pokhara to Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Take a 7-hour tourist bus ride back to Kathmandu following the Marsyangdi and Trishuli rivers. Transfer to your hotel and enjoy a final evening in Thamel.

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.details: Our representative will transfer you to the airport 3 hours before your flight for your final departure.

Tips for the guide and staff.
treks.additionalInfo: The Annapurna Circuit involves extreme elevation up to 5,416m. Proper acclimatization is vital to avoid AMS (Altitude Mountain Sickness). The trail transitions from lush lowlands to a barren, windy, and rocky high-altitude desert. Bring a reliable sleeping bag, layered clothing, and trekking poles.

faqs.question: What are the attractions of the Annapurna Circuit Trek?
faqs.answer: The circuit takes you through several climatic zones, Tibetan-style villages, the Thorong La Pass, the sacred Muktinath temple, Jomsom's bustling market, and offers views of multiple 8,000m peaks including Dhaulagiri and Manaslu.

faqs.question: What about the Annapurna Circuit altitude?
faqs.answer: The trek starts at 1,860m (Dharapani) and peaks at 5,416m at Thorong La Pass, before descending to 3,760m in Muktinath.

faqs.question: What is the difficulty level of the Annapurna Circuit Trek?
faqs.answer: The difficulty level is graded as Hard/Challenging due to the extreme elevation, harsh weather potential at the pass, and rugged, steep terrain.

treks.title: Upper Mustang Tiji Festival Jeep Tour 2025
treks.description: The Upper Mustang Tiji Festival Jeep Tour 2025 provides a breathtaking and hypnotically colorful cultural experience in the Annapurna region of Nepal. The Tiji Festival is celebrated annually in Lo Manthang, the ancient walled capital of the former Kingdom of Lo. The three-day ceremony features vibrant Tibetan Buddhist dances and rituals that celebrate the victory of good over evil. Traveling comfortably by 4WD jeep, you will cross the world's deepest gorge (Kali Gandaki), visit sacred temples like Muktinath, and explore ancient sky caves like Chhoser. Witness the mystical arid landscapes, historic monasteries, and engage with the Lobha ethnic groups during their most auspicious time of the year.
highlights: Participate in the 3-day Tiji Festival celebration (May 24-26, 2025) in Lo Manthang.
Explore the King's Palace, Champa Lhakang, and Namgyal Gompa to learn about Tibetan Buddhism.
Discover the mysterious ancient sky caves of Chhoser (Shija Jhong Cave).
Travel comfortably by private 4WD jeep through the world's deepest Kali Gandaki Gorge.
Visit Muktinath Temple, Kagbeni, Rupse Waterfall, and relax in Tatopani's hot springs.
Engage with the Bon and Lobha ethnic groups and experience their unique Himalayan lifestyle.
Stunning panoramas of Annapurna I, Tilicho, Dhaulagiri, and Nilgiri ranges.

itinerary.title: 19 May 2025 - Arrival to Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport. Our agent will provide a private transfer to your hotel. Evening briefing about the Tiji Festival tour.

itinerary.title: 20 May 2025 - Flight from Kathmandu to Pokhara (822m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic half-hour flight to Pokhara, enjoying views of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Transfer to your hotel and relax.

itinerary.title: 21 May 2025 - Drive to Tatopani from Pokhara (1190m)
itinerary.details: Drive 6-7 hours by 4WD jeep along winding roads. In the evening, relax in the natural hot springs of Tatopani.

itinerary.title: 22 May 2025 - Drive to Kagbeni via Jomsom and Muktinath (2900m)
itinerary.details: Drive 7 hours passing Marpha village and Jomsom. Visit the sacred Muktinath Temple (3800m) before returning to Kagbeni for the night.

itinerary.title: 23 May 2025 - Drive from Kagbeni to Charang (3560m)
itinerary.details: Drive 5 hours crossing the Kali Gandaki River. Pass through Chhusang, Samar, and Ghami, viewing ancient Mani walls and Tibetan plateaus.

itinerary.title: 24 May 2025 – Drive to Lo-Manthang (3810m). Tiji Festival Day 1
itinerary.details: Drive 2 hours into the walled city of Lo-Manthang. In the afternoon, head to the King's palace square to witness the vibrant first day of the Tiji Festival dances.

itinerary.title: 25 May 2025 – Tiji Festival Day 2 & Chhoser Cave
itinerary.details: Morning drive to Chhoser to explore the ancient 5-story sky caves (Shija Jhong). Return to Lo-Manthang in the afternoon for the second day of Tiji festivities.

itinerary.title: 26 May 2025 - Tiji Festival Day 3 (Final Day)
itinerary.details: Explore monasteries like Champa Lhakang and Namgyal Gompa. Join the locals in the afternoon for the dramatic conclusion of the Tiji Festival.

itinerary.title: 27 May 2025 - Drive from Lo-Manthang to Jomsom (2720m)
itinerary.details: Drive 5 hours retracing your route back through the arid landscapes to Jomsom. Enjoy local apple whiskey and celebrate your journey.

itinerary.title: 28 May 2025 - Drive back to Pokhara (822m)
itinerary.details: Drive 8 hours by jeep back to Pokhara, enjoying the scenic descent. Spend your final evening in the lakeside city.

itinerary.title: 29 May 2025 - Drive from Pokhara to Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Take a 7-hour deluxe tourist bus ride back to Kathmandu. Enjoy a farewell dinner in Thamel before your final departure.

treks.additionalInfo: The Tiji Festival is highly anticipated and accommodations in Lo Manthang fill up fast. The dates for 2025 are strictly May 24, 25, and 26. Upper Mustang is a restricted area that requires a special permit (minimum 2 travelers). The region is known for its incredible 2,000-3,000 year old sky caves, such as the 5-story Chhoser Cave.

treks.title: Chulu West Peak Climbing 21 Days
treks.description: Climb the Chulu West Peak (6,419m / 21,061ft) and make the dream of peak climbing in one of the world’s most beautiful regions come true. Standing at a height of 6,419m, the Chulu West Peak offers a thrilling mountaineering opportunity for those looking for a serious adventure in the Annapurna Region. While climbing, you will enjoy magnificent panoramic views of the Dhaulagiri, Nilgiri, Annapurna, and Manaslu ranges. The trail leads through the Annapurna Circuit to the Manang Valley, where two high camps are set up above Base Camp. After summiting, the route crosses the challenging Thorong La Pass (5,416m) and descends to the sacred Muktinath Temple before ending in Jomsom.
highlights: Climb the high-altitude Chulu West Peak (6,419m / 21,061ft).
Panoramic views of the Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, and Manaslu Himalayan ranges.
Stay in charming Gurung villages and explore the Annapurna region.
Conquer Thorong La Pass (5,416m), the highest point on the Annapurna Circuit.
Visit the Muktinath Temple, one of the most important Hindu and Buddhist shrines in Nepal.
Trek through diverse landscapes from subtropical forests to high alpine rocky terrain and icy glaciers.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350m)
itinerary.details: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Welcome dinner featuring authentic Nepalese cuisine and a cultural program.

itinerary.title: Trip Preparation Day in Kathmandu (1350m)
itinerary.details: Wander around nearby areas, shop for gear, and attend a pre-trip briefing with your guide to review equipment and team composition.

itinerary.title: Drive Kathmandu to Syange/Jagat (1410m)
itinerary.details: Take an 8-10 hour drive through the countryside via Besishahar. The road is a mix of paved and rugged dirt trails offering great views.

itinerary.title: Trek Syange/Jagat to Dharapani (1960m)
itinerary.details: Trek 7-8 hours entering the Manang district. Walk through barley, rice, and potato fields alongside pine forests to reach Dharapani.

itinerary.title: Trek Dharapani to Chame (2710m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours negotiating steep forested ridges. Enjoy views of Lamjung Himal and Annapurna II. Relax in natural hot springs in Chame.

itinerary.title: Trek Chame to Pisang (3300m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5-6 hours through a dense forest and a dramatic U-shaped valley hanging between two giant snow peaks. Overnight in Lower Pisang.

itinerary.title: Trek Upper Pisang to Manang (3519m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours via the upper route through Geru for outstanding panoramic views. Visit the large Barge Monastery before arriving in Manang.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization at Manang (3519m)
itinerary.details: Acclimatization day. Take a short hike to Bhojo Gompa, Gangapurna Lake, or the Himalayan Rescue Association clinic.

itinerary.title: Trek Manang to Leder (4200m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4-5 hours continuing through alpine landscapes and yak pastures to reach the high-altitude camp at Leder.

itinerary.title: Trek Leder to Chulu West Base Camp (4900m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4-5 hours up to the Base Camp. Enjoy stunning views of the Annapurna Himalayas and settle into your tented camp.

itinerary.title: Climb Chulu West Base Camp to Camp I (5100m)
itinerary.details: Climb 4-5 hours towards Camp I. Enjoy magnificent views of Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, Manaslu, and Gangapurna.

itinerary.title: Rest & Acclimatization at Camp I (5100m)
itinerary.details: Rest and acclimatize while climbing leaders set up Camp II and ferry equipment. Take short walks around Camp I.

itinerary.title: Climb Camp I to Camp II (5530m)
itinerary.details: Climb 4-5 hours up a rock band. Use ropes, crampons, and ice axes. Overnight at Camp II to ensure proper acclimatization for summit day.

itinerary.title: Summit Chulu West (6419m) and back to Camp I
itinerary.details: Start very early for a 9-10 hour push to the summit. Work hard through icy trails, enjoy the mind-blowing horizon, and descend safely back to Camp I.

itinerary.title: Trek Camp I to Leder (4200m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5-6 hours descending all the way back to Leder. Celebrate your successful summit in the relative warmth of lower altitudes.

itinerary.title: Contingency Day (4200m)
itinerary.details: A spare day built into the itinerary in case of bad weather, acclimatization issues, or delayed summit pushes.

itinerary.title: Trek Leder to Thorong Phedi (4600m)
itinerary.details: Trek 3-4 hours cleaning up base camp and walking an easy downhill path to Thorong Phedi, preparing for the pass crossing.

itinerary.title: Cross Thorong La (5416m) to Muktinath, Drive to Jomsom
itinerary.details: Trek 7-8 hours starting early to cross the famous Thorong La Pass. Descend to the sacred Muktinath temple, then take a 2-hour drive to Jomsom.

itinerary.title: Fly Jomsom to Pokhara (827m)
itinerary.details: Take a dramatic 30-minute flight between the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri gorges. Spend the afternoon exploring Pokhara and boating on Phewa Lake.

itinerary.title: Drive Pokhara to Kathmandu (1350m)
itinerary.details: Take a 6-7 hour drive (200km) back to Kathmandu. Relax, organize photos, and enjoy a final celebratory dinner with the trekking staff.

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.details: Transfer to the airport 3 hours before your scheduled flight for your onward journey.

Travel Insurance (covering high-altitude rescue and evacuation).
Personal expenses (phone calls, laundry, Wi-Fi, battery recharge, hot showers, extra drinks).
Tipping/gratitude for the guide and porters.
Portable Altitude Chamber (PAC).
treks.additionalInfo: Climbing Chulu West Peak requires good physical conditioning and stamina, as it is graded as Very Strenuous. Prior mountaineering experience is highly beneficial but not strictly mandatory if you are extremely fit and comfortable with ropes, crampons, and high altitudes.

treks.title: Shivapuri Day Hike with Nunnery Visit
treks.description: Escape the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu with this refreshing day hike in Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park. The journey begins with a visit to the Budhanilkantha Temple (the Sleeping Vishnu). From the park entrance, you'll hike up to the serene Nagi Gompa (a Buddhist Nunnery) where you can enjoy sweeping views of the Kathmandu Valley and the Langtang Himalayas on clear days. The hike continues through lush oak and rhododendron forests up to Baghdwar, the sacred source of the Bagmati River. Finally, you'll reach Shivapuri Peak (2,732m) to enjoy a picnic lunch in the pristine mountain air before descending.
highlights: Pass through the large Buddhist Nunnery, Nagi Gompa, and interact with the nuns.
See Baghdwar, the sacred starting point of the holy Bagmati River.
Witness rare and exotic plants, orchids, and animals inside the national park.
Visit the Budhanilkantha Temple, famous for the large reclining statue of Lord Mahavishnu.
Enjoy a lush, dense forest hike taking you to the height of 2,732m (8,963 ft).

itinerary.title: Shivapuri Day Hike with Nunnery Visit (2732m)
itinerary.details:
8:30 AM: Meet your guide and transfer to Budhanilkantha Temple for a brief tour.
9:00 AM: Drive to the National Park entry gate and begin the hike.
10:30 AM: Reach Nagi Gompa. Observe the nunnery and enjoy tea with the nuns.
11:00 AM: Continue hiking uphill through lush forests toward Baghdwar.
2:00-3:00 PM: Reach Shivapuri Peak. Enjoy a packed lunch and the panoramic views.
4:30-5:00 PM: Descend all the way back to the base and drive back to your hotel.
5:30 PM: Arrive back at your hotel.

costIncludes: Professional English-speaking tour guide.
Transfer from your hotel to the Fulbari Gate (park entrance) with a private vehicle.
Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park entrance fees.
Packed Lunch.
Pickup from Fulbari Gate and return transfer to your hotel.
2 bottles of mineral water per person.
All necessary government fees and local taxes.
costExcludes: Personal expenses.
Breakfast.
Tips for the guide and driver.
treks.additionalInfo: Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park is a crucial watershed for the Kathmandu Valley. The park is home to 177 species of birds, rare orchids, and wildlife such as wild boars, monkeys, deer, and occasionally leopards or Himalayan black bears. It's recommended to pack a windproof jacket, comfortable hiking shoes, a reusable water bottle, snacks, sun protection, and a small first aid kit.

treks.title: Mardi Himal Trek 9 Days
treks.description: The Mardi Himal Trek is a hidden gem in the Annapurna Region. Though less crowded than the Annapurna Base Camp trek, it offers breathtaking views of the Mardi Himal (5,587m), Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), and the Annapurna range. The trail winds through dense, lush rhododendron and oak forests, eventually emerging above the tree line at Badal Danda to reveal spectacular panoramic views of the snowy Himalayan peaks. Reaching the Mardi Himal Base Camp at 4,500m gives trekkers an incredible sense of accomplishment. The trek also provides opportunities to encounter rare wildlife like the Himalayan Thar and the Danphe (national bird of Nepal), and to experience the local culture in villages like Siding.

quickFacts.bestSeason: All season (Best in Spring and Autumn)

highlights: Trek on a peaceful, less crowded trail in the Annapurna Region.
Hike through lush, green rhododendron, oak, and birch forests.
Trek to Mardi Himal Base Camp (4,500m) for breathtaking panoramas of the snowy Himalayan Mountains.
Fantastic views of Mt. Dhaulagiri, Mt. Annapurna (II, III, IV, and South), Mt. Hiunchuli, and Mt. Machhapuchhare (Fishtail).
Discover the local lifestyle, culture, and traditions in the authentic village of Siding.
Enjoy the serene beauty of Pokhara, including boating on Phewa Lake and viewing the sunrise from Sarangkot.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport. Our representative will transfer you to your hotel. In the evening, attend a trek briefing with your guide.

itinerary.title: Take Tourist Deluxe Bus from Kathmandu to Pokhara (822m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic 7-hour tourist bus ride to Pokhara, following the Trishuli and Marsyangdi rivers. Relax by Phewa Lake upon arrival.

itinerary.title: Drive Pokhara to Kande - Trek to Pitam Deurali (2142m)
itinerary.details: Drive to Kande and begin trekking. Climb up to Australian Camp, pass through Pothana via rhododendron forests, and arrive at Pitam Deurali for spectacular views.

itinerary.title: Trek from Pitam Deurali to Low Camp (3050m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6 hours uphill through dense forests of birch, maple, and hemlock. Keep an eye out for wildlife as you pass Forest Camp and Rest Camp to reach Low Camp.

itinerary.title: Trek from Low Camp to High Camp (3600m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4 hours ascending above the tree line along the Badal Danda ridge. Enjoy stunning, unobstructed views of Machhapuchhre and the Annapurna range.

itinerary.title: Trek to Mardi Base Camp (4500m) then down to Badal Danda (3250m)
itinerary.details: Start early for a challenging 5-hour ascent to Mardi Himal Base Camp (4,500m). Enjoy the sweeping mountain panoramas, then descend to Badal Danda for the night.

itinerary.title: Trek down to Siding (1700m) then take Shared Jeep to Pokhara (827m)
itinerary.details: Descend to the traditional village of Siding instead of retracing the exact same route. After lunch, take a shared jeep back to Pokhara to celebrate your trek.

itinerary.title: Fly from Pokhara to Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Early morning visit to Sarangkot for sunrise views over the Himalayas. After breakfast, take a scenic 25-minute flight back to Kathmandu. Farewell dinner in the evening.

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.details: Transfer to the airport 3 hours before your scheduled flight for your onward journey.

treks.title: Annapurna Base Camp Trek 8 Days
treks.description: The Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) Short Trek is a condensed version of the classic 14-day itinerary, offering a unique combination of natural beauty and adventure in a shorter timeframe. The trek takes you up close to some of the world's most spectacular mountain landscapes. Starting from the lush foothills near Pokhara, you'll hike through rhododendron and bamboo forests, pass through traditional Gurung villages like Chomrong and Sinuwa, and ascend the Modi Khola glacier valley. The trail culminates at Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m), providing a 360-degree panoramic view of the majestic Annapurna massif. Along the way, relax in the natural hot springs of Jhinu Danda.
highlights: Taking a flight to Pokhara is equivalent to taking a scenic mountain flight.
Visit ethnic communities like Birethanti, Jhinu Danda, Chhomrong, Sinuwa, and Deurali.
See both Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC) and Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) in one short trek.
Witness breathtaking peaks including Fishtail, Nilgiri, Gangapurna, Annapurna I, II, and South.
Immerse yourself in Jhinu Danda's magnificent natural hot springs (Tatopani).
Experience spectacular sunrises over the Annapurna massif and sunsets over Machhapuchhre.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Our agent will meet you at the airport and provide a private transfer to your hotel. Attend an evening briefing on the Annapurna Base Camp Short Trek itinerary.

itinerary.title: Fly Kathmandu to Pokhara (822m) - Drive to Siwai (1530m) - Trek to Chomrong (2170m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic morning flight to Pokhara. Drive 2-3 hours to Siwai, where the trek begins. After lunch, hike up stone stairs to the beautiful village of Chomrong.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chomrong (2170m) to Dovan (2600m)
itinerary.details: Descend to the Chomrong Khola, cross a suspension bridge, and climb up to Sinuwa. Walk through bamboo and rhododendron forests before descending steeply into Dovan.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dovan (2600m) to Deurali (3230m)
itinerary.details: Trek quietly through the sacred Modi Khola gorge. Pass through Himalaya and Hinku Cave, watching the landscape shift from forest to glacial valley before reaching Deurali.

itinerary.title: Trek from Deurali (3230m) to Annapurna Base Camp (4130m)
itinerary.details: Ascend past Machhapuchhre Base Camp into the sanctuary. Walk on less vegetated paths until you reach ABC. Enjoy 360-degree views of the Annapurna range.

itinerary.title: Trek from Annapurna Base Camp (4130m) to Sinuwa (2360m)
itinerary.details: Wake up early for a spectacular sunrise over the peaks. After breakfast, descend the valley, retracing your steps through MBC, Dovan, and Bamboo back to Sinuwa.

itinerary.title: Trek from Sinuwa (2360m) to Siwai (2170m) - Drive to Pokhara (822m)
itinerary.details: Trek down to Jhinu Danda to relax in the natural hot springs. Continue to Siwai, where a private vehicle will drive you back to Pokhara. Enjoy the evening by Phewa Lake.

itinerary.title: Drive from Pokhara (822m) to Kathmandu (1300m)
itinerary.details: Take a 7-hour scenic tourist bus ride back to Kathmandu following the Marsyangdi and Trishuli rivers. Enjoy a farewell dinner in Thamel.

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.details: Transfer to the airport 3 hours before your scheduled flight for your onward journey.

treks.title: Everest Base Camp Trek Fix Departures 2026 Nepal
treks.description: Reaching the summit of a mountain gives great satisfaction, but nothing is more rewarding than the ultimate challenge of trekking to Everest Base Camp. This 14-day fixed departure journey begins with a thrilling flight to Lukla and takes you deep into the heart of the Khumbu region. Along the way, you'll experience the incredible hospitality of the indigenous Sherpa people, visit ancient monasteries like Tengboche, and walk through the delicate, high-altitude terrain of Sagarmatha National Park. The trail leads you past the Khumbu Glacier up to Everest Base Camp (5,364m) and the iconic Kala Patthar viewpoint (5,555m) for unparalleled sunrise views over the world's highest peak, Mount Everest (8,848m).
highlights: A scenic, thrilling flight to Lukla to begin your EBC journey.
Explore the culture, traditions, and legendary hospitality of the local Sherpa people.
Magnificent views of Mount Everest (8,848m), Lhotse, Cho Oyu, and Makalu.
Explore the delicate flora and fauna of the UNESCO-listed Sagarmatha National Park.
Visit the ancient Tengboche Monastery (3,867m), the largest Buddhist monastery in the Khumbu region.
Walk alongside the Khumbu Glacier (the highest glacier on Earth) and stand at Everest Base Camp (5,364m).
Hike up to Kala Patthar (5,555m) for awe-inspiring sunrise views over Mt. Everest.

itinerary.title: Flight to Lukla (2850m) & Trek to Phakding (2650m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic flight from Kathmandu (or Manthali during peak season) to Lukla. Begin your trek with a gentle descent through Chaurikharka village to Phakding.

itinerary.title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.details: Trek along the Dudh Koshi River, crossing the famous Hillary Suspension Bridge. Enter Sagarmatha National Park and climb a steep trail to reach Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day at Namche Bazaar
itinerary.details: Rest and acclimatize in the bustling Sherpa capital. Hike up to the Everest View Hotel for your first breathtaking panorama of Mount Everest, or visit the Hillary School.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche to Tengboche/Deboche (3855m)
itinerary.details: Hike through forests, potentially spotting musk deer or Himalayan Tahrs. Descend to Phunki Thenga and climb up to Tengboche to visit the famous monastery. Overnight in Deboche.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tengboche to Dingboche (4360m)
itinerary.details: Pass ancient mani walls, chortens, and the village of Pangboche with stunning views of Ama Dablam. Trek through high-altitude barley and potato fields to reach Dingboche.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day at Dingboche
itinerary.details: Take an acclimatization hike up the ridge above Dingboche to help your body adjust to the thin air, enjoying spectacular views of Makalu and Island Peak.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dingboche to Lobuche (4930m)
itinerary.details: Ascend toward the Thukla Pass, where you will see poignant memorial statues for fallen climbers. Continue alongside the Khumbu Glacier moraine to Lobuche.

itinerary.title: Trek to EBC (5364m) & back to Gorak Shep (5185m)
itinerary.details: Trek to Gorak Shep, drop your bags, and push on to Everest Base Camp. Stand at the foot of the world's highest peak, surrounded by the Khumbu Icefall, then return to Gorak Shep.

itinerary.title: Hike to Kala Patthar (5555m) & Trek to Pheriche (4250m)
itinerary.details: Wake up before dawn to hike up Kala Patthar for the most iconic sunrise view of Mount Everest. Descend back to Gorak Shep for breakfast, then trek down to Pheriche.

itinerary.title: Trek from Pheriche to Tengboche (3855m)
itinerary.details: Descend rapidly through rhododendron and juniper forests, crossing the Imja Khola, and make your way back to the beautiful setting of Tengboche.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tengboche to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.details: Trek back through the forests, enjoying views of Lhotse and Everest one last time before arriving back at the comforts of Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche Bazaar to Phakding (2650m)
itinerary.details: A sharp descent back down to the Dudh Koshi River, crossing multiple suspension bridges, brings you back to the quiet village of Phakding.

itinerary.title: Trek from Phakding to Lukla (2850m)
itinerary.details: Complete your final day of trekking with a gentle uphill walk back to Lukla. Celebrate the success of your EBC journey with your guides and porters.

itinerary.title: Fly back to Kathmandu/Manthali from Lukla
itinerary.details: Take a morning flight back out of the mountains. Transfer back to your hotel in Kathmandu to relax and recount your incredible Himalayan adventure.

treks.title: Poon Hill Trek 2 Days
treks.description: The 2 Days Poon Hill Trek is a gem among Nepalese treks. Short, sweet, and packed with magnificent views of snow-covered mountains and lush green landscapes, this trek perfectly captures the beauty of the Annapurna region in a limited timeframe. You will travel through stunning rhododendron and oak forests, pass picturesque Gurung and Magar villages, and experience authentic local hospitality. The highlight of the trip is an early morning hike to the Poon Hill viewpoint (3,210m) to witness one of the most breathtaking sunrises in the Himalayas, illuminating Mount Dhaulagiri, Annapurna I, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), and numerous other peaks.

quickFacts.bestSeason: March to May & Sept to Nov

highlights: A quick, highly rewarding excursion from Pokhara to the famous Poon Hill and back.
One of Nepal's shortest treks offering the greatest views of the Himalayas.
Trek through stunning rhododendron forests, home to diverse flora and wildlife.
Experience the warm hospitality and distinctive culture of the Gurung and Magar people.
A fully guided journey ensuring you catch the iconic sunrise and 360-degree mountain vista from Poon Hill.
Enjoy the flavor of genuine Thakali Khana sets while staying in locally run tea houses.

itinerary.title: Drive Pokhara (850m) to Banthati (2300m) & Trek to Ghorepani (2900m)
itinerary.details: Option 1: Morning departure from your Pokhara hotel. Option 2: Early flight from Kathmandu to Pokhara, then jump right into a jeep. Drive 4-5 hours past Nayapul, Hile, and Ulleri to Banthati. After lunch in Banthati, trek approximately 3 hours uphill through meadows and dense rhododendron forests to reach Ghorepani. Rest at a comfortable tea house for the night.

itinerary.title: Hike to Poon Hill (3210m) - Trek back to Banthati (2300m) - Drive back to Pokhara
itinerary.details: Wake up before daybreak for a 45-minute hike to Poon Hill. Watch an awe-inspiring sunrise paint the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges in brilliant colors. Descend back to Ghorepani for a hearty breakfast. Hike 3 hours downhill to Banthati, where your jeep awaits. Enjoy a scenic 5-hour drive back to Pokhara to conclude your trek.

treks.title: Island Peak Climbing
treks.description: If you have dreamed of climbing a technical 6,000-meter Himalayan summit, Island Peak (Imja Tse) is the ultimate adventure. Used as a training peak by Sir Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay in 1953, the route remains largely unchanged. The journey begins with a trek through the beautiful Khumbu valley, allowing for excellent acclimatization and taking you past iconic Sherpa villages, the famous Tengboche Monastery, and stunning views of Ama Dablam, Everest, Lhotse, and Nuptse. The climb itself requires negotiating crevassed glaciers with ladders, using a jumar on fixed lines, and traversing a narrow, exposed ridge to the summit (6,189m), making it perfect for those looking to experience real mountaineering.
highlights: Summit Island Peak (6,189m) and take in the awe-inspiring panoramic views from the top.
Amazing views of Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, Pumori, Ama Dablam, Thamserku, and Makalu.
Experience traditional Sherpa settlements and their rich Tibetan Buddhist culture and hospitality.
Visit Tengboche Monastery, the largest and most famous monastery in the Everest Region.
Learn and use high-altitude alpine skills: glacier travel, crevasses, fixed ropes, and jumars.
Explore the unique alpine flora and wildlife within Sagarmatha National Park.

itinerary.title: Arrival In Kathmandu (1350m)
itinerary.details: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport. Our representative will transfer you to your hotel in Thamel. Rest, explore the vibrant streets, and prepare for the adventure.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Kathmandu, Briefing & Preparation
itinerary.details: Guided tour of UNESCO World Heritage Sites including Boudhanath Stupa and Pashupatinath Temple. Afternoon briefing, introduction to your climbing guide, and gear check.

itinerary.title: Fly to Lukla and trek to Phakding (2650m)
itinerary.details: Take a thrilling 35-minute scenic flight to Lukla. Begin trekking with a short, 3-hour hike through the Dudh Koshi valley to the village of Phakding.

itinerary.title: Trek to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.details: Cross the Dudh-Koshi River several times, enter Sagarmatha National Park at Monjo, and climb a steep ascent to reach Namche Bazaar, the bustling Sherpa capital.

itinerary.title: Rest day & Acclimatization in Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.details: Acclimatize by hiking up to Syangboche and the Everest View Hotel for your first great views of Mt. Everest. Optional visit to Khumjung Village to see the Yeti Skull.

itinerary.title: Trek to Tengboche (3900m)
itinerary.details: Trek along a scenic trail to Tengboche. Visit the famous Tengboche Monastery and enjoy a 360-degree panorama of Everest, Nuptse, Lhotse, and Ama Dablam.

itinerary.title: Trek to Dingboche (4360m)
itinerary.details: Descend into a birch and rhododendron forest, cross the Imja River, and pass through Pangboche. The tree line ends as you ascend to the stone-walled fields of Dingboche.

itinerary.title: Trek to Chhukung (4730m)
itinerary.details: A short, 2-hour walk takes you deeper into the Imja Valley. The incredible south face of Lhotse and the pyramidal peak of Island Peak dominate the skyline.

itinerary.title: Trek to Island Peak Base Camp (5090m)
itinerary.details: Hike past the Lhotse glacier moraines to reach Island Peak Base Camp. You will sleep in tented camps tonight and rest to acclimatize for the climb.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization & Climbing Preparation Day at Base Camp
itinerary.details: Your guides will provide training on peak climbing techniques, including the use of ice axes, climbing boots, crampons, harnesses, ascenders (jumars), and ropes.

itinerary.title: Island Peak Summit Day (6189m) & Return to Chhukung
itinerary.details: Wake up past midnight and start the climb. Ascend steep rock channels, cross the glacier avoiding crevasses, and jumar up the steep headwall to the summit ridge. After celebrating, descend to Chhukung.

itinerary.title: Spare day for extra safety
itinerary.details: A contingency day built into the itinerary in case of bad weather or if additional acclimatization is required before the summit push.

itinerary.title: Trek to Tengboche (3900m)
itinerary.details: With the immense satisfaction of summiting a 6,000m peak, retrace your steps down the Imja valley through Pangboche back to Tengboche.

itinerary.title: Trek to Monjo (2835m)
itinerary.details: Descend steeply from Tengboche, cross the Dudh Koshi River at Phunki Thenga, and hike past Namche Bazaar down to the village of Monjo.

itinerary.title: Trek to Lukla (2860m)
itinerary.details: The final day of trekking. Walk a leveled trail back to Lukla. Celebrate the success of your expedition with your guides and porters in the evening.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kathmandu (1350m)
itinerary.details: Take an early morning 40-minute scenic flight back to Kathmandu. Transfer to your hotel to freshen up and enjoy a complimentary farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Final departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Transfer to the airport 3 hours prior to your scheduled flight for your onward journey.

treks.title: Mera Peak Climbing
treks.description: Mera Peak (6,461m) is the highest trekking peak in Nepal. Located in the wild, pristine, and rarely visited Hinku Valley of the Everest Region, it is a favorite for climbers seeking a non-technical yet high-altitude challenge. This 13-day itinerary is the shortest route to the summit, taking you across the high Zatrwa La Pass and through secluded forests and yak pastures. Though technically straightforward, the extreme altitude and cold make it a formidable test of endurance. The reward at the summit is an unparalleled, close-up panorama of five 8,000-meter peaks: Mount Everest, Kanchenjunga, Lhotse, Cho Oyu, and Makalu.
highlights: Climb the highest trekking peak in Nepal (6,461m) with an experienced local Sherpa crew.
Take the shortest and most direct route to the summit via the challenging Zatrwa La Pass (4,600m).
Trek off-the-beaten-path through the wild, pristine, and secluded Hinku Valley.
Experience a straightforward route to the summit with minimal technical climbing required.
Incredible close-up views of five 8,000-meter peaks from the summit (Everest, Kanchenjunga, Lhotse, Cho Oyu, Makalu).
Led by an Everest summiteer with more than 20 years of mountaineering experience.

itinerary.title: Fly to Lukla & trek to Chutanga (3100m)
itinerary.details: Take a morning flight to Lukla (from Kathmandu or Manthali). Meet your crew and begin trekking up through forests and fields to the small settlement of Chutanga.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chutanga to Thuli Kharka (4300m) via Zatrwa La (4600m)
itinerary.details: A tough, steep climb past rhododendron forests to the Zatrwa La Pass, separating the Khumbu and Hinku Valleys. Descend to the yak pastures of Thuli Kharka.

itinerary.title: Trek from Thuli Kharka to Kothe (3691m)
itinerary.details: Descend into the Hinku Valley through beautiful pine and rhododendron forests. Enjoy outstanding views of Kusum Kanguru and the south face of Mera Peak.

itinerary.title: Trek from Kothe to Thaknak (4358m)
itinerary.details: Hike up the Hinku valley past the tree line. Stop at a 200-year-old Buddhist shrine, Lungsumgba Gompa, for a puja (prayer) ceremony for a successful climb.

itinerary.title: Trek from Thaknak to Khare (5045m)
itinerary.details: Ascend the Dig Glacier moraine, weave past the glacial lake of Charpati Tal, and climb up to Khare, the Mera Peak Base Camp.

itinerary.title: At Khare – Acclimatization Day and pre-climb training
itinerary.details: Rest and participate in pre-climb training with your guides. Practice using your harness, ascender (jumar), crampons, and ropes on a nearby rocky slope.

itinerary.title: Trek from Khare to Mera High Camp (5780m)
itinerary.details: Hike up a steep, rocky path to Mera La, then make a straightforward ascent up the Mera Glacier to High Camp. Enjoy spectacular views of 5 eight-thousanders. Sleep in tents.

itinerary.title: Summit Mera Peak (6461m) and trek down to Khare (5045m)
itinerary.details: Start at 2 AM. Rope up and ascend the glacier in the freezing cold. Use jumars on a fixed rope for the final steep 50m to the summit dome. Celebrate, then descend to Khare.

itinerary.title: Contingency Day for Mera Peak Summit
itinerary.details: A reserved day built into the itinerary in case the summit push is delayed due to bad weather or health issues.

itinerary.title: Trek from Khare to Kothe to Thuli Kharka (4300m)
itinerary.details: A long day of retracing your steps back down the Hinku Valley, past Kothe, and hiking back up to the summer yak pastures of Thuli Kharka.

itinerary.title: Trek to Lukla (2840m) via Zatrwa La Pass (4600m)
itinerary.details: Cross the Zatrwa La pass one final time, enjoying the incredible views of the Khumbu before a steep descent back into Lukla to celebrate your success.

itinerary.title: Fly from Lukla to Kathmandu (1400m)
itinerary.details: Take an early morning flight back to Kathmandu. Transfer to your hotel to relax and enjoy the rest of the day exploring Thamel.

itinerary.title: Depart Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Transfer to the international airport 3 hours before your flight for your onward journey.

Domestic flights (Kathmandu/Manthali – Lukla – Kathmandu/Manthali) and airport departure taxes.
13 days accommodation (12 nights in tea houses/lodges, 1 night in a tented camp at High Camp).
Standard meals (15 Breakfasts, 14 Lunches, and 14 Dinners with seasonal fruits).
Group climbing gears and supplies (ropes, ice screws, snow bars).
All camping equipment (kitchen tent, dining tent, toilet tent, tables, chairs, utensils).
Government licensed, experienced trekking/climbing leader, cook, and porters (1 porter for 2 trekkers, max 18kg).
Staff coverage (meals, insurance, salary, lodging, transportation, flights, equipment).
Mera Peak Climbing Permit, Sagarmatha National Park Entry Permit & TIMS Card fees.
Farewell dinner and a Good Karma Trekking climbing achievement certificate.
