Meals and accommodations in Kathmandu (before and after the trek).
Personal expenses (laundry, telephone calls, bar bills, hot/cold drinks, battery recharge, hot showers).
Personal clothing and technical climbing gear (boots size 12+ must be brought from home).
Travel insurance covering high-altitude rescue and evacuation (Mandatory).
Tips and gratitude for guides and porters.
treks.additionalInfo: Mera Peak is highly recommended for fit hikers wanting their first Himalayan summit experience. While it requires very little technical climbing, the extreme altitude (6,461m) makes it physically exhausting. Proper acclimatization and high-quality cold-weather gear (especially double boots) are absolutely critical for a safe ascent.

treks.title: Phulchowki Day Hike with Botanical Garden Visit
treks.description: Escape the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu Valley with a fantastic day hike to Phulchowki Hill. Standing at 2,750m, it is the highest hill encircling the valley. 'Phulchowki' translates to 'hill full of flowers,' and true to its name, it comes alive in spring with vibrant rhododendrons, magnolias, and wildflowers. This 5-6 hour hike offers fresh country air, tranquility, and a rich biodiversity of birds and butterflies. From the summit, you'll be rewarded with a sweeping aerial view of the valley and a breathtaking panorama of the snow-capped Himalayas, stretching from Annapurna and Manaslu in the west to the Everest range in the east. The day concludes with a refreshing visit to the National Botanical Garden in Godawari.
highlights: A perfect 5-6 hour day escape to the tallest hill near the Kathmandu Valley.
Ideal for all ages of travelers, families, solo hikers, and students.
Explore rich biodiversity along the route, including lush vegetation, wildflowers, and rare bird species.
Enjoy stunning panoramic views of the Himalayas (Annapurna, Langtang, Ganesh, Everest).
Witness a superb aerial view of Kathmandu Valley from the top of the hill.
Explore the Phulchowki Mai temple and discover its local religious significance.
Visit the beautiful, 82-hectare National Botanical Garden in Godawari.

itinerary.title: Phulchowki day hike with botanical Garden visit
itinerary.details:
8:30 AM: Pick up from your hotel in Kathmandu and drive to Godawari (approx. 14km / 1 hr).
9:30 AM: Begin the hike up through dense, verdant forests toward Phulchowki Hill.
2:00 PM: Reach the summit, explore Phulchowki Mai temple, enjoy your packed lunch with mountain views, and begin the descent.
2:30 PM: Arrive back at the base for a brief visit to the National Botanical Garden to explore the diverse plant life and enjoy some snacks.
4:00 PM: Drive back to Kathmandu.
5:00 PM: Drop off at your hotel.

costIncludes: Professional English-speaking tour guide.
Transfer from your hotel to Godawari and back with a private vehicle.
National Botanical Garden / Park entrance fees.
Packed Lunch (Veg, Vegan, or Non-Veg based on your preference).
2 bottles of mineral water per person.
All necessary government fees and local taxes.
costExcludes: Personal expenses.
Breakfast.
Tips for the guide and driver.
treks.additionalInfo: Phulchowki is an excellent warm-up or acclimatization hike if you are preparing for a longer trek (like EBC or ABC), or just a great way to spend a free day in Kathmandu. It's highly recommended for bird watchers (look for the Rufous-bellied Niltava and the Spiny Babbler). During winter (Dec-Feb), the hilltop often experiences beautiful snowfall.

faqs.question: Is it safe to hike Phulchowki alone, or should I join a group?
faqs.answer: While it is possible to hike alone, we recommend hiking with a group or a guide. The trails can be confusing in places, and a Good Karma Trekking Guide can greatly enhance your trip with their local knowledge.

faqs.question: What kind of scenery and views can I expect on the Phulchowki hike?
faqs.answer: Along the trail, you will witness diverse vegetation, beautiful flowers, and stunning landscapes. From the top, you will see a wonderful aerial panorama of Kathmandu Valley and a mesmerizing distant view of snow-capped mountains.

faqs.question: What level of fitness is required for the Phulchowki hike?
faqs.answer: You should be in general good health. While it is not technical climbing, it does involve 3 to 4 hours of continuous uphill walking and around 2 hours of downhill walking.

faqs.question: Can I expect to see any unique flora or fauna on the Phulchowki hike?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can see rhododendrons, orchids, magnolias, ferns, and herbal plants. You may also come across various bird species like pheasants, the Spiny Babbler (Nepal's endemic bird), Himalayan Monal, butterflies, and occasionally monkeys.

treks.title: Chandragiri Hill Hike and Return by Cable Car
treks.description: Chandragiri Hill (2,551m) is a premier day-trip destination located in the southwest of the Kathmandu Valley, blending natural beauty with profound historical and religious significance. This unique itinerary combines the best of both worlds: a scenic, uphill hike through lush natural forest trails, followed by a relaxing and spectacular 9-minute descent via the Chandragiri Cable Car. From the hilltop, visitors are treated to an unbroken, mind-blowing panorama of the Himalayas spanning from Mt. Api and Manaslu in the west, to Everest and Kanchenjunga in the east. The day concludes with a side trip to explore Kirtipur, an ancient and culturally rich Newari city.

quickFacts.distance: Approx 4 km hike up / 2.4 km cable car down

highlights: Witness a mind-blowing panorama of the Ganesh Himal, Manaslu, Langtang Ranges, Everest, and Gaurishankar.
Enjoy the perfect combination of an active nature hike up the hill and a relaxing scenic cable car ride down.
Escape the hustle and bustle of the Kathmandu valley for a refreshing day in nature.
Visit the Bhaleshwor Mahadev Temple, a deeply significant Hindu pilgrimage site at the hilltop.
Learn about the unification of Nepal by visiting the statue of King Prithvi Narayan Shah.
Explore the ancient Newari city of Kirtipur on your way back.

itinerary.title: Chandragiri Hill Hike, Cable Car Return & Kirtipur Tour
itinerary.details:
8:30 AM: Meet your guide at the hotel and drive to Thankot (14km / 45 min).
9:30 AM: Begin the 4km uphill hike through natural forest trails, ascending 1,000 meters in elevation.
1:30 PM: Reach the top of Chandragiri Hill (2,551m). Enjoy refreshment, lunch, and explore the Bhaleshwor Mahadev temple, the King Prithvi Narayan Shah statue, and take in the panoramic Himalayan views.
3:00 PM: Enjoy a scenic 9-minute descent via the Chandragiri Cable Car back to the base.
4:00 PM: Take a side trip to Kirtipur, an ancient Newari city, to explore its Durbar Square and narrow alleys.
5:30 PM - 6:00 PM: Drive back and drop off at your hotel in Kathmandu.

costIncludes: Professional English-speaking tour guide.
Private vehicle transfer from your hotel to Thankot, and later pickup from the base.
Packed Lunch or Lunch at the hilltop restaurant.
One-way Chandragiri Cable Car ticket for the descent.
National Park / Conservation area entrance fees.
2 bottles of mineral water per person.
All necessary government fees and local taxes.
costExcludes: Personal expenses and souvenirs.
Breakfast.
Tips and gratitude for the guide and driver.
treks.additionalInfo: Chandragiri holds deep mythological significance as the site where Sati Devi's forehead is believed to have fallen, resulting in the Bhaleshwor Mahadev temple. It also holds historical weight; King Prithvi Narayan Shah planned the unification of the Kathmandu Valley from this very viewpoint. The 2.4km cable car system, opened in 2016, offers a stunning bird's-eye view of the dense forests and the valley below.

treks.title: Everest Three Passes Trek
treks.description: The Everest Three High Passes Trek is the ultimate adventure for thrill-seekers in the Khumbu region. Not only does it take you to the iconic Everest Base Camp (5,364m) and Kala Patthar (5,555m), but it also challenges you to cross the region's three highest and most formidable mountain passes: Kongma La (5,535m), Cho La (5,420m), and Renjo La (5,340m). This 17-day circuit breaks away from the crowded classic trails to explore the remote and pristine Gokyo Lakes, the rugged Thame valley, and the longest glacier in the Himalayas, Ngozumpa. This trek promises an unparalleled, immersive experience of Sherpa culture and the absolute best panoramic views the Himalayas have to offer.
highlights: Cross three formidable high mountain passes: Renjo La (5,340m), Cho La (5,420m), and Kongma La (5,535m).
Witness spellbinding, panoramic views of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu from Gokyo Ri and Kala Patthar.
Explore the pristine, turquoise Gokyo Lakes and cross the Ngozumpa Glacier, the longest in the Himalayas.
Trek to the iconic Everest Base Camp (5,364m) and explore the Khumbu Glacier.
Immerse yourself in authentic Sherpa culture at Namche Bazaar, Thame, and the ancient Tengboche Monastery.
Spot rare wildlife such as musk deer, colorful Himalayan pheasants, and possibly the elusive snow leopard.

itinerary.title: Flight to Lukla (2850m) & Trek to Phakding (2650m)
itinerary.details: Take a scenic, thrilling 40-minute flight from Kathmandu (or Manthali) to Lukla. Begin your trek by descending to the Dudh Koshi river and hiking to Phakding.

itinerary.title: Trek to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.details: Cross multiple suspension bridges, enter Sagarmatha National Park, and climb a steep ascent through pine forests to reach Namche Bazaar, the Sherpa capital.

itinerary.title: Rest day to acclimatize at Namche Bazaar
itinerary.details: Spend the day exploring Namche, visiting the local museums, hiking up to the Everest View Hotel, or visiting the Khumjung Monastery to see the Yeti skull.

itinerary.title: Trek to Thame (3750m)
itinerary.details: Diverge from the classic EBC trail and follow the Bhote Koshi River to Thame, the childhood home of Tenzing Norgay Sherpa.

itinerary.title: Trek to Lungden (4500m)
itinerary.details: Hike through the remote landscape to the last village in the valley, Lungden, passing ancient Tibetan trade routes.

itinerary.title: Cross Renjo La Pass (5446m) & Trek to Gokyo Lake (4750m)
itinerary.details: Tackle your first high pass, Renjo La. Enjoy majestic views of Everest and Makalu before carefully descending to the pristine Gokyo Lakes.

itinerary.title: Acclimatize at Gokyo & Hike Gokyo Ri (5400m)
itinerary.details: Early morning hike up Gokyo Ri for what many consider the best panoramic view in the entire Everest region. Spend the rest of the day resting at Gokyo.

itinerary.title: Trek to Thangnak (4700m)
itinerary.details: Cross the massive Ngozumpa Glacier. The trail is rocky with several ups and downs, leading to a small collection of lodges at Thangnak.

itinerary.title: Cross Cho La Pass (5420m) & Trek to Dzongla (4855m)
itinerary.details: A challenging day crossing the steep and often icy Cho La Pass. The effort is rewarded with spectacular views as you descend into Dzongla.

itinerary.title: Trek to Lobuche (4910m)
itinerary.details: Follow the moraine and descend alongside Chola Lake, eventually rejoining the classic EBC trail at Lobuche.

itinerary.title: Trek to Everest Base Camp (5364m) & Return to Gorak Shep (5185m)
itinerary.details: Hike along the Khumbu Glacier to reach Everest Base Camp. Celebrate your arrival at the foot of the world's highest peak before descending to Gorak Shep to sleep.

itinerary.title: Hike Kala Patthar (5555m) & Trek to Lobuche (4910m)
itinerary.details: Wake up before dawn to climb Kala Patthar for a breathtaking sunrise over Mount Everest. Descend to Gorak Shep for breakfast, then trek back down to Lobuche.

itinerary.title: Cross Kongma La Pass (5535m) & Trek to Chhukung (4730m)
itinerary.details: Tackle the highest and most difficult of the three passes, Kongma La. Descend into the Chhukung valley, a popular area for trekking peaks.

itinerary.title: Trek to Tengboche (3855m)
itinerary.details: Descend the Imja Khola valley through Dingboche and Pangboche. Arrive at Tengboche and visit the largest and most famous monastery in the region.

itinerary.title: Trek to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.details: Hike down through rhododendron and pine forests, crossing the Dudh Koshi river, and climb back up to Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Trek to Lukla (2850m)
itinerary.details: Your final day of trekking. Walk down to the Hillary Suspension Bridge and continue through local villages back to Lukla to celebrate the end of your circuit.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kathmandu / Manthali
itinerary.details: Take an early morning flight back from Lukla. Transfer to your hotel in Kathmandu and enjoy a farewell dinner in the evening.

treks.additionalInfo: The Everest Three Passes Trek is highly demanding and is recommended for experienced trekkers with excellent physical fitness. The itinerary involves crossing three passes over 5,300m and multiple days sleeping above 4,500m. Strict adherence to acclimatization protocols and comprehensive cold-weather gear are essential.

treks.title: Jamacho Day Hike
treks.description: The Jamacho Day Hike is a wonderful, accessible escape into nature, located just a short drive from Thamel. Situated within the Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park, this lush, forested trail offers an immersive experience filled with diverse plants, colorful butterflies, and the melodies of over 300 species of birds. At the 2,130m summit, you will find the sacred Jamacho Gompa and an ancient meditation cave. A view tower rewards hikers with a sweeping bird's-eye view of the Kathmandu Valley and a breathtaking Himalayan panorama featuring Mt. Manaslu, Ganesh Himal, Jugal, Dorje Lakpa, and the Langtang massif.
highlights: Enjoy panoramic views of the Himalayas including Manaslu, Ganesh Himal, Jugal, Dorje Lakpa, and Langtang.
Get a sweeping bird's-eye view of the entire Kathmandu Valley from the summit tower.
Explore the ancient meditation cave of philosopher Acharya Nagarjuna and visit the Jamacho Gompa.
Escape the busy city and immerse yourself in a pristine forest filled with birds and butterflies.
Optionally extend your trip to visit the nearby Osho Tapoban meditation center.

itinerary.title: Jamacho Day Hike
itinerary.details:
9:00 AM: Drive via private vehicle from your hotel in Kathmandu to the Phulbari Gate (approx. 15-20 mins from Thamel).
9:30 AM: Begin the hike up through the dense forests of the Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park.
12:00 PM: Reach the Jamacho Peak (2,130m).
12:00 PM - 1:00 PM: Explore the monastery, visit the meditation cave, enjoy your packed lunch, and take in the panoramic Himalayan views.
1:00 PM: Begin the descent back through the forest.
2:30 PM: Arrive back at the Phulbari Gate.
2:30 PM - 4:00 PM: Optional side trip to visit Osho Tapoban and try fresh Himalayan Trout fish nearby.
4:00 PM - 5:00 PM: Drive back and drop off at your hotel in Kathmandu.

costIncludes: Professional English-speaking tour guide.
Private vehicle transfer from your hotel to the Phulbari Gate and back.
Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park entrance fees.
Basic Packed Lunch.
2 bottles of mineral water per person.
All necessary government fees and local taxes.
costExcludes: Personal expenses.
Breakfast.
Tips and gratitude for the guide and driver.
Extra transfer costs and entrance fees if extending the trip to Osho Tapoban or the Trout farm.
treks.additionalInfo: Nagarjun Hill holds deep mythological significance. It is named after the Buddhist philosopher Acharya Nagarjuna, who meditated in a cave here. According to legend, a young buffalo herder meditated so intensely here that he transformed into a buffalo, leaving horn tracks on the cave ceiling before ascending to heaven. The area is also popular for rock climbing and cycling.
